# threaded its traversal-invariant arguments through the new verify_ctx_t
# context struct — it now takes 3: (verify_ctx_t *ctx, short context, rule *r).
# Task 6.3 (#234) split the 338-line body into one static handler per node
# type; the handlers take ctx plus the per-level rule cursor (2 params), with
# verify_leaf adding the context argument (3), verify_not_backtrack the failed
# son (3) and verify_and_son the two node-state flags it folds into (5). All
# of these now live in tips_eval.c after the Task 6.4 (#235) four-way split.
